title: Product delivery
description: Account for trustworthy product delivery by preserving candidate identity, compatibility, integrity, and applicable execution authority across package production, installation, and release coordination.
responsibilities: Compose candidate production, verified installation, and release coordination so downstream actions refer to the actual selected candidate and its applicable qualification.
Keep package integrity, installation destination effects, publication authority, and observed release outcomes distinct while preserving their end-to-end relationship.

Provide IF-006 as the accountable installation contract for Product delivery. MOD-014 retains acquisition, verification, bounded destination changes, and outcome behavior; candidate production and release responsibilities retain their own boundaries.

includes: Product candidate construction and integrity, compatible bounded installation, release qualification/publication, and recovery of delivery outcomes.
excludes: Engineering decision governance, published activity methods, operational record persistence, and a change to product behavior merely from hierarchy adoption.
Duplicate ownership of candidate artifacts, installed state, or release facts already assigned to a child.

design_limits: MOD-019 provides IF-006 directly to MOD-010. MOD-014 retains its installation Functions and state authority; IF-005 remains internal to candidate production, installation, and release cooperation.

MOD-015 consumes Governance IF-009 authority and IF-010 evidence-applicability support for SCN-066. Release qualification, publication, actual public observations, IR-010 AR derivation, further Interfaces, and physical qualification remain separately accountable work.
Contract analysis adds no direct parent Function, AR, persistent state, or new physical realization. Detailed IF-006 implementation mapping remains deferred.

sources.basis: Proposed parent responsibility derived from the existing child definitions and the user-selected containment structure. The parent owns the stated composition boundary; child definitions, direct allocations, state authority, and contracts retain their identities and meaning. This is draft architecture, not implementation adoption or satisfaction.

Refine contract accountability: MOD-018 provides IF-004 and MOD-019 provides IF-006. MOD-010 and MOD-014 retain their behavioral allocations and state responsibilities. This supersedes the provider/exposure choice recorded by SRC-MODULE-HIERARCHY without changing Interface guarantees, consumers, Function/AR allocations, or realization observations. Earlier source entries retain their prior design meaning; this draft refinement supplies no runtime adoption or satisfaction evidence.

sources.locator: MOD-019; SCN-019, SCN-053, SCN-066 selected collaboration analysis
sources.basis: Derive consumer-focused parent contracts for selected-state inspection, adopted-REM authoring guidance, applicable action authority, and evidence applicability. Preserve child behavior/state authority, existing Function/AR allocations, and earlier contract guarantees. The selected contracts refine prior blanket deferrals; remaining retention, wider collaboration, AR, and realization gaps stay explicit. This is draft design analysis, not implemented or satisfied behavior.
